description: This Java source file defines the Inspector class, which analyzes a parsed Android bugreport. Its functions include associating processes and threads, detecting ANRs, deadlocks, and lock states, merging logs, and tagging interesting log lines for presentation. Essentially, it contains the core logic for understanding and annotating bug reports for diagnostic purposes.

classes.name: Inspector
classes.description: Main class responsible for analyzing parsed bugreport data, establishing relationships among processes, threads, logs, and stack traces, and annotating data for diagnostics.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Static method that initiates the inspection of a given Bugreport instance by creating an Inspector object and calling its inspect method.

methods.name: makeProcessInfo
methods.description: Gathers process and thread information from various VmTraces objects within the bugreport and associates them with known processes and threads.

methods.name: findAnr
methods.description: Detects an Application Not Responding (ANR) event from the system log, and assigns it to the bugreport.

methods.name: inspectProcesses
methods.description: Performs various analyses like lock combination, binder thread marking, deadlock detection on a list of processes.

methods.name: combineLocks
methods.description: Aggregates lock information from Java stack frames for each thread to identify locks held or blocked.

methods.name: markBinderThreads
methods.description: Identifies threads involved in binder transactions by examining stack frames.

methods.name: markOutgoingBinderThread
methods.description: Detects if a thread is performing an outgoing binder transaction by analyzing its stack frames.

methods.name: markIncomingBinderThread
methods.description: Detects if a thread is handling an inbound binder transaction via stack inspection.

methods.name: fixBinderClass
methods.description: Refines binder class names by removing inner class suffixes or adjusting based on naming conventions.

methods.name: markBlockedThreads
methods.description: Marks threads as blocked if they are holding locks or waiting on resources.

methods.name: isThreadBlocked
methods.description: Checks contents of locks held by a thread to determine if it is blocked.

methods.name: markInterestingThreads
methods.description: Flags threads that are of interest based on certain behaviors like being binder threads or runnable.

methods.name: isThreadInteresting
methods.description: Decides whether a thread should be considered interesting based on its state or activities.

methods.name: matchesJavaStack
methods.description: Checks if a thread's Java stack matches a specified sequence of method signatures.

methods.name: markDeadlocks
methods.description: Detects deadlocks among threads and marks involved processes.

methods.name: inventLogcatTimes
methods.description: Fills in missing timestamps in log lines based on neighboring lines.

methods.name: mergeLogcat
methods.description: Combines system and event log sections into a single chronologically ordered log.

methods.name: markLogcatProcessesAndThreads
methods.description: Associates log lines with corresponding process and thread information.

methods.name: markAnrLogcatRegions
methods.description: Identifies log sections corresponding to ANR events based on patterns.

methods.name: markAnrRegion
methods.description: Tags log lines that fall within a specified time window as part of an ANR incident.

methods.name: markBugreportRegions
methods.description: Marks log lines that occurred during the window when the bugreport was captured.

methods.name: trimLogcat
methods.description: Reduces logcat lines to a manageable subset centered around the start time of the bugreport.
